raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the genealogical relationship after confirming that Archduke Leopold Salvator’s parents were Archduke Karl Salvator and Princess Maria Immaculata of Bourbon-Two Sicilies. It incorrectly elevated one generation and identified Karl Salvator’s mother (Princess Maria Antonia of the Two Sicilies) as Dolores’s paternal grandmother—confusing a paternal great-grandmother with the paternal grandmother. The correct paternal grandmother is Princess Maria Immaculata.
